Controls.Title: Camera access from the lock screen must be disabled.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Deferred: confirm a physical or redirected camera; DISA marks camera-free systems not applicable.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Do not manufacture a finding on a VM without a camera.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: See the DISA check/fix for the stated applicability or management dependency.

Controls.Title: The display of slide shows on the lock screen must be disabled.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Verify expected lock-screen behavior after the next sign-in; no remote-access policy is changed.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Control Panel >> Personalization >> "Prevent enabling lock screen slide show" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: The system must be configured to ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Deferred: confirm NetBIOS/WINS dependencies and policy-template ownership.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Network behavior and restart requirements need environment review.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: See the DISA check/fix for the stated applicability or management dependency.

Controls.Title: Downloading print driver packages over HTTP must be prevented.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Prevents HTTP print-driver downloads; confirm no required printer setup depends on them.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Use an approved alternative driver distribution method if printing is needed.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> System >> Internet Communication Management >> Internet Communication settings >> "Turn off downloading of print drivers over HTTP" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: Printing over HTTP must be prevented.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Prevents HTTP printing; confirm no required lab workflow uses it.
Controls.OperationalNotes: This does not stop the spooler or alter firewall rules; test any required printing separately.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> System >> Internet Communication Management >> Internet Communication settings >> "Turn off printing over HTTP" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: Autoplay must be turned off for non-volume devices.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Disables automatic actions for non-volume devices.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Manual device access remains a separate behavior to validate on the approved VM.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> AutoPlay Policies >> "Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: The default autorun behavior must be configured to prevent autorun commands.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Prevents AutoRun commands from executing automatically.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Manual program launch is outside this setting; do not use real malicious media for testing.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> AutoPlay Policies >> "Set the default behavior for AutoRun" to "Enabled:Do not execute any autorun commands".

Controls.Title: Autoplay must be disabled for all drives.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Disables AutoPlay across all drive types; the required decimal value is 255.
Controls.OperationalNotes: A value of 1 is not equivalent to the all-drive mask. Test with harmless media only if separately approved.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> AutoPlay Policies >> "Turn off AutoPlay" to "Enabled:All Drives".

Controls.Title: Attachments must be prevented from being downloaded from RSS feeds.
Controls.OperationalNotes: The policy path retains Internet Explorer naming; do not install or enable a legacy browser to demonstrate it.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> RSS Feeds >> "Prevent downloading of enclosures" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: Indexing of encrypted files must be turned off.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Deferred: DISA distinguishes GPO and Intune paths; the management channel is unknown.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Do not write the PolicyManager current-state cache as a substitute for changing the owning Intune policy.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: See the DISA check/fix for the stated applicability or management dependency.

Controls.Title: Users must be prevented from changing installation options.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Removes user control of privileged Windows Installer options.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Check that necessary software installation workflows still function; no software installation is performed by this package.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> Windows Installer >> "Allow user control over installs" to "Disabled".

Controls.Title: The Windows Installer feature "Always install with elevated privileges" must be disabled.
Controls.OperationalNotes: The DISA check targets HKLM; this package does not change HKCU or claim to assess all user policy state.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> Windows Installer >> "Always install with elevated privileges" to "Disabled".

Controls.Title: PowerShell script block logging must be enabled on Windows 11.
Controls.OperationalNotes: Logging may capture sensitive script content and increase log volume. Confirm retention and disclosure rules; do not publish raw event logs. This does not establish PowerShell 7 logging coverage.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> Windows PowerShell >> "Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging" to "Enabled".

Controls.Title: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not use Basic authentication.
Controls.SelectionNotes: Deferred: establish WinRM authentication dependencies before disabling Basic.
Controls.OperationalNotes: This may affect management or scanning workflows and needs explicit compatibility review.
Controls.PolicyGuidance: See the DISA check/fix for the stated applicability or management dependency.
